name: Cozy Realms
description:
🌟 A peaceful, relaxing, and chill place to play Minecraft! Cozy Realms is a family-friendly survival server where players of all ages can build, explore, and make new friends in a brand-new world. 🌍

🏠 Key Features:

👫 Friendly Community: Meet awesome people in a welcoming environment!

🎮 Crossplay (Java & Bedrock): Play from any Bedrock device, including mobile, Nintendo Switch, and more!

🌍 Survival: Classic Minecraft survival gameplay in a calm, serene setting.

⚰️ Keep Inventory: No need to stress over losing your items; keep them safe, even after death.

🧭 Latest 26.2 Version: Enjoy the latest features with our server running on version 26.2! Explore the new sulfur caves!

💰 Economy: Earn money by selling items, creating chest shops, and engaging in a thriving in-game economy!

🔒 Anti-Grief: Protect your builds and play without worry, thanks to our strong anti-grief measures.

💼 Jobs: Find your role in our world with various jobs to earn in-game currency.

🌲 Resource Zone: A dedicated space for gathering resources, so the main world stays beautiful.

🆕 New World: Explore our freshly generated world with endless possibilities!

🌐 Live 3D Map: Check out our world’s live 3D map directly on our website!

🏆 Ranks: Level up through in-game ranks to unlock unique perks and rewards!

⏰ Playtime Rewards: Earn exciting rewards based on your playtime levels.

🎉 Monthly Events: Join in on fun, engaging events every month!

⚔️ MCMMO: Train and level up RPG skills to enhance your gameplay experience!

👥 Dedicated Staffs: Our dedicated staff members are always here to help and ensure a great experience!

🌈 Join us on Cozy Realms and find your perfect balance of fun, relaxation, and community! ✨

IP: play.cozyrealms.us

Discord: discord.cozyrealms.us

Store: store.cozyrealms.us

Ports: 25565 (Java) 19132 (Bedrock)

We can't wait to welcome you to the family! 🌻
